entries.title: Find customers using more details
entries.description: Search customers by company, contact, phone, email, VAT number, address, notes, or ID.

entries.title: Keep editing while tables refresh
entries.description: Focused fields now remain active when table data updates, preventing interrupted typing.

entries.title: Manage production with focused access
entries.description: The new Job Manager role lets users view and update production jobs without broader administrative access.

entries.title: Add costing materials more easily
entries.description: Search the raw-material catalogue and see readable Part and Department labels. Loading states, missing-Part details, field spacing, and guidance for average utilization are also clearer.

entries.title: Work with quotes as a procurement manager
entries.description: Procurement managers can now view, create, and update quotes, with quote dashboards available alongside their existing procurement tools.

entries.title: Manage production with focused access
entries.description: Users assigned the new Job Manager role can view and update production jobs without broader administrative access.

entries.title: Work with quotes as a procurement manager
entries.description: Procurement managers can now access the Quotes tab and create or update quotes while assigning the appropriate salesperson.
